name: Djeff :: Anthöny :: Quant :: Switch Club :: Porto - 6 Nov
description: Djeff, Anthöny, and Quant perform at Switch Club in Porto on November 6. The event is organized by Disquiet and features house, melodic house & techno, tech house, and afro house music.
longDescription:
Djeff, Anthöny, and Quant are set to perform at Switch Club in Porto on November 6. The event, organized by Disquiet, starts at 11:00 PM and runs until 6:00 AM.

The night promises a mix of house, melodic house & techno, tech house, and afro house music. Tickets are available starting at €15.00, with a 'Late Ticket' priced at €20.00 going on sale soon. An 'Early Bird' ticket for €12.00 is already sold out.

Switch Club is located at Rua de Júlio Dinis 766, 4050-101 Porto. Attendees can resell their tickets through the Shotgun app if their plans change.
